I am extremely disappointed with how this move-in was handled.

⚠️ SCAMMER / FRAUD WARNING — PLEASE BE CAREFUL

Based on my personal experience, I believe I was scammed in connection with an immigration and LMIA employment arrangement. I was asked to pay $40,000 in cash for an LMIA/employment opportunity. I was then informed by the employer that they could only offer approximately $12 per hour, despite previously being told that the job would pay around $40 per hour.

I also became extremely concerned about the use of a closed employer/work permit arrangement. From my experience, I believe the situation was structured in a way that left me dependent on the employer and vulnerable to pressure, stress, and emotional distress. I felt that this situation was being used to control and pressure me rather than to provide the employment opportunity that had originally been promised.

The person involved also represented herself in a way that gave me confidence in her credibility, including my understanding that she held a position at the University of Alberta. This made me trust her and believe the immigration process was legitimate.

I consider what happened to me extremely serious and believe it should be investigated by the appropriate immigration and law-enforcement authorities. I have retained messages, documents, payment-related records, employment information, and other evidence and am prepared to provide them to the authorities.

I am posting this review to warn others: PLEASE VERIFY THE EMPLOYER, LMIA, JOB OFFER, WAGE, WORK PERMIT CONDITIONS, AND ANY PAYMENT REQUESTS BEFORE GIVING MONEY OR PERSONAL DOCUMENTS.

Based on my experience, I believe this person acted as a scammer, and I believe the circumstances may involve criminal conduct. I hope the appropriate authorities thoroughly investigate the matter and review all available records.

PLEASE BE CAREFUL. DO NOT TRUST ANYONE BLINDLY WITH YOUR IMMIGRATION STATUS OR YOUR MONEY.

⭐ 1/5

Extremely disappointing experience at Craftsman Collision Marine Drive.

I brought my vehicle in through an ICBC claim on June 23. Before the repairs, I provided them with an official Lexus inspection report showing damage to the ball joint and suspension. Despite being aware of these issues, they only replaced the front right tire and returned my vehicle without addressing the major safety concerns.

On top of that, I was charged an additional “overtime” fee, as the owner called it, because the employee took longer than expected.

I contacted the owner today to explain that I felt I had paid far too much for the service I received. Instead of trying to resolve the issue professionally, she told me that I had “missed my appointment” even though I was physically at the salon and had paid the deposit. She then told me to come back to the salon and threatened to call the police on me.

For a $150 service, I expected professional work, reasonable timing, and professional customer service. Unfortunately, I received none of those.

I would not return to this salon, and I would recommend that others carefully consider their experience before booking.

⭐☆☆☆☆ Unprofessional Conduct and a Highly Disappointing Experience

My experience with this immigration lawyer was extremely disappointing due to the lack of professionalism, disrespectful behaviour, and concerns regarding the handling of an immigration matter. Immigration cases are extremely sensitive, as they can directly affect a client’s future, career opportunities, and ability to build a life in Canada.

I believe every client deserves respectful communication, transparency, accountability, and competent professional guidance. Unfortunately, my experience fell significantly short of these expectations and caused considerable stress and concern about the potential impact on my future.

An immigration lawyer has a serious responsibility to understand the importance of their work and treat clients’ cases with the care and attention they deserve. Professionalism, ethical conduct, and clear communication should be fundamental standards, not optional qualities.

Based on my personal experience, I would encourage anyone seeking immigration services to carefully research their options, clarify expectations, and maintain written records of all communications before proceeding.

Immigration decisions can shape a person’s entire future. Every client deserves to be treated with dignity, respect, and professionalism.

one_star_reviews.text:
Be careful before you buy!!!

My experience with this contractor was extremely disappointing and, unfortunately, very stressful.

Before the purchase, communication and service seemed very good. However, once the house was purchased and problems arose, my experience completely changed. I encountered several issues with my new home and had great difficulty getting answers, callbacks, and, most importantly, concrete solutions.

What is particularly frustrating is having to constantly follow up on things that should normally be taken care of after the delivery of a new house. I often felt that my concerns weren't taken seriously and that the after-sales service was far from what I expected.

I invested a very significant portion of my savings in this house. Instead of being able to peacefully enjoy my new property, this situation caused me a great deal of stress and worry, to the point of affecting my sleep and well-being.

I am currently in the process of filing a claim with the Residential Construction Guarantee (GCR) to have the problems requiring repairs recognized and resolved. I therefore want to share my experience so that future buyers can do their due diligence and pay close attention to after-sales service, warranties, and how correction requests are handled after the sale.

Personally, my experience so far has fallen far short of what I expected when buying a new home. I strongly recommend that future buyers thoroughly research the contractor, ask for references, and carefully review testimonials from previous clients before making a commitment.

I’d like to express my disappointment with my experience. I paid $70 and waited almost an hour for frozen gyoza and ramen that was nothing special. The ramen broth was particularly disappointing—tasteless and essentially like water with noodles.

The service was far too slow, and having two waiters and only one chef clearly affected the experience. The team should work more efficiently together, and proper cross-training could help.

I raised my concerns with the manager, who explained that one staff member was new. I understand that, but it’s not an excuse for poor service. Given the long wait and disappointing food, I expected at least a small gesture of goodwill, such as complimentary drinks, rather than just an apology.

Overall, I expected much more for $70 and hope you take this feedback seriously.

We had a really bad experience dealing with Jaskamal from S3 Mortgage. As first-time home buyers, we were already dealing with a lot of stress, and unfortunately, our experience with Jaskamal added significantly to that stress.

We were also being offered / forced for a higher interest rate while dealing with him, and when we needed help resolving the issues, he refused to provide the support we expected based on what had previously been promised.

Eventually, we decided to move our mortgage file directly to a bank branch. To our surprise, we were approved within just two days, without the hassle and stress we had experienced previously.

We also felt that we were put in a very difficult position when we were asked for additional down payment, which made an already stressful home-buying process even more difficult.

As first-time home buyers, we expected clear communication, professionalism, and support throughout such an important process. Unfortunately, that was not our experience.

one_star_reviews.text:
Dryden Ontario.

I am writing to report a highly unprofessional interaction I experienced this morning when attempting to transfer propane service to our new home.

We recently moved into the property, and the previous owner informed us that your company supplies the propane tank. When I called to set up service, the representative who answered was immediately aggressive. After I had said little more than a greeting, she began yelling, demanding, “Who was the owner?”

I was taken aback by the tone and politely asked her to clarify what she meant. She then became even more hostile and began screaming, “Who was the last owner of the house?”

I have never experienced someone screaming at me on the phone after I had said almost nothing. I was dumbfounded and could not believe the way I was being spoken to. I explained that I could not immediately recall the previous owner’s last name and offered my address instead. She responded loud, dismissively and rudely, stating that she needed the name and would not proceed otherwise. I told her I would call back later.

The representative’s yelling and aggressive tone were unprofessional and completely unprovoked. I was simply trying to establish service as a new customer and was met with hostility rather than assistance. This experience was unacceptable and does not reflect the standard of customer service I expect when dealing with an essential utility.

The phone was lasted maybe 40 seconds....

I will be switching to Superior propane.

UNBELIEVABLE!

one_star_reviews.text: We had my son assessed by neuropsychologist at the CERC. Having been assessed myself at a different clinic as a young adult, I was not happy with our experience at the CERC. Neuropsychological assessments are very expensive, and we expected better care for that price. Our son has significant difficulties that greatly affect family life, and following the assessment, we were not referred to any specific resources, even though, according to my research, several other services offered at the CERC could have helped us. After receiving the report, we felt abandoned with our problems. We emailed the neuropsychologist a question a few months after the assessment and received no response. Amidst these difficulties, as others have mentioned, our initial appointment was scheduled and then canceled with only a few days' notice, before we were placed back on the waiting list. We now plan to have the assessment redone and start the process from the beginning at another clinic to receive better care.

Extremely unprofessional clinic.

Our son finally started treatment after months and months of being placed and re-placed on the waitlist here. Now, he is placed again on the waitlist despite starting active treatment.

We have respected every deadline and information demand and yet they cannot even communicate clearly their expectations. See the two attached images. The first asks us to fill in an appointment request form before Aug 21st (which we did) and nowhere does it state first-come-first-serve (this is not ethical for clients in active treatment), and yet in the second image the reply we receive makes it sounds like we were too slow to reply. This is not how you plan a caseload, it is highly unethical.

I can share many more emails I have received from this clinic apologizing for their poor communication and mismanagement. It's embarrassing at this point. One time we waited 20 days just for an appointment details (e.g. meeting link) once our son's assessment was confirmed and at the last minute they put us back on the waitlist.

We liked the psychoeducator Arianne but even she complained at how gate-kept communication is. We don't have any direct contact with her, everything is routed through the clinic. They also demand payment before any service is given. It is a highly inefficient model, puts unnecessary burden on the client, and for a clinic that can't seem to communicate in a timely manner, they want to centralize all communication. This makes no sense.

We are both healthcare providers working in private practice so we know how the system can work. Our complaints aren't baseless as we operate in similar systems as CERC. We will be looking elsewhere for our son. I hope anyone reading this has a better experience, but for us it has been a nightmare.

one_star_reviews.text: I’m extremely disappointed with my recent experiences at this Urban Kids location. I came in on both Thursday night and Friday morning and unfortunately had a poor experience both times. On Thursday, I was last-minute birthday shopping for my daughter and had seen the BOGO 50% promotion in the window. I already knew exactly what I wanted and was aware the mall was closing soon, but it was only around 8:55. When I walked over to enter the store, the doors were already closed and locked. I looked at the two workers inside and asked if they were closed, and they gave me a dirty look, said they were closing, and then laughed as I walked away. I returned Friday morning and immediately recognized the same woman from Thursday night. After shopping for a while, I asked to speak to the manager to complain about the previous night’s behaviour, only to find out that the same woman was actually the manager!! I was shocked that this kind of treatment came from management. I was even more shocked that the manager was so unprofessional and seemed to be doing nothing but standing behind the counter all morning. I’ve enjoyed shopping here in the past, but after this experience, I’m not sure I’ll be returning.

Wouldn't trust these guys with a leaf blower!
Elite was hired by my neighbour to install a fence around their backyard along three separate property lines.
The Elite crew began the work by driving their tractor through my yard in order to pull the existing fence posts and auger new holes. There was no attempt to discuss this with me in advance or get any permission to access and tear up the entire length of my yard.
While drilling the new holes, the Elite crew removed the rear property pins from both sides of the backyard. There is no way this ignorant / illegal action happens by mistake twice!
After excavation it was apparent that all 15 holes drilled encrouched onto my side of the property line. Once again, zero discussion with me on this at all.
We asked the company to stop work until the lines could be re established by a registered land surveyor.
Over a month goes by with no word from Elite. They have caution tape strewn over the fifteen 4' deep holes running up the side of my driveway. There was no attempt to smooth out the ruts made by the tracks on their tractor. Most respectable companies would use plywood to guard against this type of damage. They just left the ruts and mess from the holes up my driveway.
Elite asks me to share the cost of replacing the pin. I declined the notion that I should pay (~$375) for this companies negligence.
The Elite crew coinsedently backed their landscape trailer over a pilon that was placed over fresh asphalt at the end of my driveway. They backed the trailer so far over my driveway / culvert that it pushed in the other side of the ditch and gouged / scraped my new asphalt. This manuever happened TWICE over a bright orange pilon.
They had no business at my property or my neighbours property at this time.
The CEO of the company said they would go out for quotes and make it right.
August 13

Recently had a tattoo done by Niki. I had communicated with her what I wanted and even sent her the template. When I arrived she was late getting there. Then had to get everything ready. Be wary of getting a tattoo done here.

I went to Dive Pub last night and unfortunately left feeling extremely uncomfortable and disappointed with how I was treated by one of the servers.

At one point, I went slightly behind the bar because I was trying to get a waitress’s attention to ask for some water. I understand that I shouldn’t have gone behind the bar, and I was completely willing to step back around. However, instead of simply asking me to move, the server came up behind me and put her hands on me and pushed me away from the bar.

I was also trying to explain that I wanted to get water from the other server because, on previous occasions, I had been given very warm/hot tap water when asking for water. I didn’t feel comfortable continuing to be served by her, and I respectfully asked to have the other server instead.

I went back around the bar, but security was then called and I was asked to leave.

What really bothered me was that the situation escalated to the point of me being physically pushed when the issue could have been handled simply and professionally by asking me to step away from the bar or having security deal with it.

I’ve also noticed that I’m not the only person leaving negative feedback about the bartenders/servers and the way customers are being treated. When you start seeing multiple reviews raising concerns about the same type of behaviour, I think management should take those complaints seriously and actually look into what’s happening.

People go to a bar to have a good time, and disagreements with customers are going to happen. But staff should be trained to handle those situations professionally and without putting their hands on customers.

I hope management reviews what happened, speaks with the employees involved, and takes the concerns being raised in other reviews seriously. This experience was extremely unprofessional and not how I expected to be treated as a customer.

one_star_reviews.text:
**Completely Unacceptable Service from UPS**

My shipment has been sitting at the UPS facility in Regina, Saskatchewan, for two days with no movement and no estimated delivery date.

When I called UPS Customer Service to ask why it was not moving, the representative was shockingly rude and dismissive. He told me, “That’s what it is—you need to wait until they scan it.” I explained that it had already been scanned and that the latest update clearly showed it at the Regina facility. His response was that because of the long holiday, UPS prioritizes Express shipments over Standard shipments, and I would simply have to wait another five to seven days.

I understand that holidays can cause delays, but that does not excuse leaving a shipment sitting in a facility without an ETA—or treating a paying customer as though their concerns do not matter. Standard shipping should not mean second-class service, no communication, and no accountability.

This was one of the worst customer-service experiences I have ever had. Instead of offering assistance, an explanation, or even basic courtesy, the representative made it clear that UPS simply did not care. The delay was already frustrating, but the disrespectful attitude made the situation much worse.

UPS has completely lost my trust and my future business. I will avoid using UPS whenever possible and would not recommend them to anyone who expects reliable delivery, useful tracking, or respectful customer service.

I am writing to formally express my serious concern regarding the level of service and communication I have experienced at EB Medical. I have tried calling the clinic multiple times, but the reception experience has been extremely disappointing. When we ask reception staff to please communicate our concern to the doctor on our behalf, there often appears to be little effort to actually assist or follow up.

I got pierced here about 4 years ago and have since learned a lot more about piercings. Do not go here. Let’s start with all the things done wrong:
1. When I walked in, the whole shop smelled like cigarette smoke
2. I was pierced using surgical steel, which a doctor told me I had an allergic reaction to. New piercings should only be performed with titanium or gold.
3. The lobe piercings I got are crooked/not symmetrical. Somehow, my Claire’s ones (don’t recommend that either) are less crooked.

I took a look at the shop’s FB page and other things stand out
1. Most piercings should be done using flatback studs. I saw a tragus pierced with a hoop.
2. Snake/frog eye piercings, which are considered unsafe by many in the industry.
3. The profile pic is widely racist, enough said.

I wish I knew a reputable place in Windsor to recommend, but I’ve since moved. Actually, finding a reputable piercer in my new city and getting another safe piercing today prompted me to come write this. All I can say is do not go here, despite the other reviews, and instead take some time to learn about safe piercings.

one_star_reviews.text:
As a parent of a daughter who attended this place for almost two years, I’m writing to express my growing concerns and the decline in the quality of care she receives.

Over the past few months, the management has changed, and many teachers have left, replaced by new hires. This rapid turnover has created a sense of instability and uncertainty for my daughter.

The new teachers have struggled to build relationships with my daughter and seem indifferent to her needs. This show their real experience in dealing with toddlers. Whenever I’ve raised concerns, such as the replacement of the in-house chef with cheaper catering, they dismiss my worries, claiming it’s for the best of the child. I even told them that any changes to agreed-upon conditions require both parties’ approval, not just the manager’s decision. This lack of consideration for my daughter’s feelings and needs is concerning.

One particularly troubling incidents occurred when I dropped my daughter off in the morning last month. The room teacher responsible for supervising early drop-off children repeatedly asked me for her name, and I noticed that her served breakfast shall be thrown away because it wasn’t fresh fruit or cookies that had been left out for a couple of days. Additionally, her booty training was stopped, and I believe the new teachers used a command tone instead of a kind and encouraging approach. I stopped hearing the word “please” from my daughter and instead heard “harry up” or “do this now.”

The daily reports have also become overly positive, stating that my daughter “ate all” and that everything is great. This lack of honest feedback has eroded my trust in the school and made it difficult for me to ask questions or seek improvements.

In conclusion, this school is no longer a trusted place for my daughter. The owner needs to take more responsibility for the quality of care provided and involve more parent in decision-making like switching to catering, or do their best to maintain the trust staff with new hires. High turnover and leaving many children the day care gives a clear indication of how badly things happen. If they still care about their business, they must address these issues promptly.

one_star_reviews.text:
0/5 A disgrace to professionalism
I strongly advise against this clinic if you're coming from the public system. My experience was a complete nightmare from beginning to end.

I had my first appointment with the surgeon in October for surgery scheduled for February. They therefore had months to inform me of the criteria I needed to meet. Yet, they waited until three days before the operation to tell me my surgery was canceled. I had already taken time off work.
Five months later, they called me back for a new date in June, which was also canceled. I was then given July, and then three days before, they called to tell me that July was no longer possible and that I had to accept a date in three days. I refused and asked to be put back on the public waiting list—which wasn't even done.
A week later, they finally called me back for surgery on September 16th. This time, my weight met the criteria I had been given, and the surgery was confirmed. And guess what? Four days before the surgery, they canceled again, telling me I didn't meet their BMI criteria, even though I was below the BMI of 40 they had told me I needed.

Once again, I had organized my work and life around this surgery.

I understand that there are medical criteria. What I find completely unacceptable is systematically waiting until a few days before the operation to communicate them or change the conditions.
After several months of waiting, multiple cancellations, and wasted time off work, I have absolutely no confidence in this clinic anymore.
A lack of communication, organization, and respect for patients. I absolutely do not recommend them.

one_star_reviews.text:
This is a religious place, and we go there to pray and spend some peaceful time. I want to clarify that what I am about to say is not about the place itself, but about a specific person.

I visited there to borrow some utensils for my charity work. First of all, the lady, who I believe is the wife of the main person there, has never treated me nicely. Every time, I have had to ask, "Aunty, please help me figure out which ones you would like to give." Her response was often, "Ohhh, pata ni, duje bande nu puch."
One person helped me as he was also speaking with her. He gave me two utensils. They were not large ones, just medium-sized.

Unfortunately, due to a family emergency, I had to leave the city for about 12 to 13 days. Before leaving, I told my friend to return the utensils, and I also tried calling. I was very stressed because of the sudden emergency.

Later, the lady called my workplace and even contacted my previous landlord, saying things like, "Oh kudi sada 2 bhande la ke chali gayi." After that, other people started using the same words about me.
Everything in the Gurdwara Sahib is donated through charity. I called her husband and said, "Uncle, I sincerely apologize for the delay, but why is your wife telling everyone that I ran away with the utensils?" I returned them as well.

I am really disappointed by her behaviour. I have heard many things about people there, but for me, none of that is important. God is watching everything and is everywhere.

To be honest, I am still stressed about leaving the house because I do not know how many people she told that **"main bhande la ke bhaj gayi."** That was very hurtful and disappointing, especially when I had already explained my family emergency and eventually returned

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with Realty Key Group was extremely disappointing and ultimately became one of the most difficult management relationships our condominium Corporation has dealt with. I am a volunteer Board member and have always been very hands-on with our property, so many owners and residents know me and have my contact information. During onboarding, RKG encouraged me to step back and assured us their team would handle the day-to-day responsibilities. Unfortunately, that was not our experience. One of my biggest concerns was the lack of professional guidance. I understand management takes direction from the Board, but we hired professional management for recommendations, options and advice based on condominium experience. Instead, I was routinely asked how I wanted matters handled, sometimes regarding situations where I found the questions concerning given, they were coming from the company owner. Management regularly emphasized protecting the Corporation from legal exposure, yet there were occasions where Board motions proceeded and notices were distributed, only for us to later learn the action should not have proceeded, and the notices had to be retracted. We expected management to identify those risks beforehand and advise us accordingly. Administrative and operational issues were ongoing, including concerns with intercom updates, fob management, record keeping, and the after-hours emergency service. There were situations where contractors were not contacted because issues were deemed “non-emergencies,” despite the Board believing immediate action was necessary. In two instances, the Board contacted contractors ourselves because of the potential seriousness of the situation. Collections were another significant concern. I did not feel certain arrears were being actively pursued, or that sufficient recommendations were being made regarding escalation, including contacting mortgagees or legal counsel where appropriate. I eventually became directly involved in collection efforts myself. I was also concerned to learn that a maintenance contractor being used was the company owner’s spouse, who was also involved in management. Our Board had not initially understood this relationship. Early maintenance reporting included detailed logs, hours and before-and-after photos; that level of reporting later stopped while maintenance concerns remained outstanding. After the Board formally raised concerns regarding communication, transparency, reporting and accountability, RKG exercised its contractual right to terminate our agreement with 60 days’ notice. Unfortunately, the final two months have become increasingly adversarial. The transition involved disputes regarding legal files, documentation, proposed additional fees, incomplete records, and even how the termination could be documented in Board minutes. The final communications were particularly disappointing. What should have been a professional transition became personal and defensive. A member of the management team ultimately referred to Board members as “mean girls” and stated further responses would be deleted. The Board was then blamed for AGM information not being finalized despite us having raised the AGM, selected the date and attempted to move the process forward. Replacing management is disruptive and was not a decision taken lightly. We repeatedly attempted to address concerns and improve the relationship. Unfortunately, I felt legitimate client concerns were increasingly taken personally rather than treated as professional feedback.Every condominium corporation may have a different experience. This review reflects my experience as a volunteer Board member.  I am relieved that the transition is complete and we can move forward.
I fully expect RKG may respond disputing my account, and they are entitled to provide their perspective. I simply ask that I not be personally contacted or pressured regarding this review. Based on what I observed following reviews posted by some of our owners, I have no interest in engaging in that type of communication.

This is burnt meat, not Oreo cookies. Service is good. Atmosphere is good. However, the food is a 1 star. Here on a Saturday evening, and there’s only one employee. Additionally, there needs to be better training. I have gone to many pitaland locations but this did not truly represent the brand at all. The employee put the smallest portions and burnt the meat. I had to make another trip back to get the meal again. The worker did give it for free and apologized which was the right move. However the whole experience wasn’t great. Small portions and burnt meat. Not impressed at all and I strongly urge pitaland to check this location out again on a random trip (owner not notified). I blame the whole problem here on the owner and management.

one_star_reviews.text:
We came here on a Sunday afternoon to sit down and enjoy a coffee, and unfortunately the experience was quite disappointing.

The photos online show beautiful coffees served in proper cups, so we were expecting something similar. Instead, even though we clearly said we were having our coffee here, both coffees were served in disposable paper cups, as shown in the photo. It felt more like getting a takeaway coffee than sitting down at a coffee shop.

We paid over $25 for two coffees, one slice of banana bread, and one oat bar. The banana bread was okay, but the oat bar was quite bland. Considering the price, the overall quality and presentation were disappointing.

For more than $25, I expected a much better café experience. What bothered me most was the difference between the experience presented in the photos and what we actually received.
